headline: SeAH Aerospace & Defense Becomes Korea's First Aluminum Alloy Supplier for Airbus
summary: SeAH Aerospace & Defense (SeAH A&D) announced a historic long-term agreement (LTA) to supply high-strength aluminum alloy materials to Airbus. Formalized at the Farnborough International Airshow 2026, this milestone contract makes SeAH A&D the first Korean materials company to secure such a direct supply agreement with Airbus.
